Reveal.description: An enemy within {[range]} hexes that is not <style="Debuff_Revealed">Revealed</style> and has defeated a friendly <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> unit this battle becomes <style="Debuff_Revealed">Revealed</style> for {[nrOfRounds]} rounds. Friendly <style="Faction_Aeldari">Aeldari</style> that attack <style="Debuff_Revealed">Revealed</style> enemies ignore any hit reductions and deal <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmgPct]}% Damage</style>.
